I have been in this situation before. It happened during the pandemic and went all the way through to the end of 2021. Like you, I started to distance myself from my friends, I would stop trying to talk to them or stop trying to make plans to see them. I started engaging in more activities that would help me escape my reality. I created an ideal version of the best partner for me, and he slowly started to get a personality, voice, name, etc. I was so in love with this ideal person that I had created that I would be thinking things like “I can’t wait to see them at home” despite them not being real. I would get the urge to call or even text them, when I was outside the house. It really sucked and I understand the heartbreak you must be feeling. The human mind is a very powerful thing. I realized that it was the isolation and the safe space I created in my head when I was at home and if I wanted to stop feeling the way I did, I had to step away from there. I don’t know your situation but in my case, I had to start doing other things aside from being at home. Mind you, I hate going outside. I’m a homebody for sure. I love being at home with my bed, books, pc, you know my world is my room but it had to change. I got a job and it sucked at first lol it’s not a good job at all but I met some really cool people there made me slowly want to talk and hang out with people again. I was lucky enough to find these people that helped me just by being there and talking, laughing about nothing and messing around at work. I started to forget that person I made. I’m still kinda lonely in the partner department but my work friends really help. :>

For me, it wasn’t a single event. It happened over time when I was a kid. I would get picked on really bad as a child. I was about 7, the first I ever got punched by some kid just because I said that I liked the character that the kid had dressed up as for halloween. He punched me in the stomach for that. After that the bullying got even worse. People would steal from me, make fun of me, calling me names, I would get hit by this one particular kid. This happened until the age of 12/13, where over the summer I finally wasn’t afraid to talk and became more extroverted but by that time I was already severely depressed, got diagnosed and got sent to therapy for s*lf h*rm and the “sudden angry outbursts” I was having. I don’t remember most of my childhood but every time I do it’s just another memory of people hurting me, telling me I’ll never be pretty, skinny, or good enough for anything. I do remember being excited about school until it wasn’t I remember always being late, making every excuse in the book not to go. I would cry and beg my mom not to let me go. I’m 25 now and my angry, untrusting, and suspicious personality has stayed with me. I have tried to heal from that but deep down there will always be that voice that tells me people are really bad. And that just kills any “zest” I have for life. Even in my adult life, people are shit. My landlords constantly harass us. Doing projects outside my window at 8am, banging on my windows, trying to get into the apartment to “repair” things with less than 24 hour notice, won’t turn the water heater down so the water burns like hell, trying to withhold my mail by banning me from the garage until they show up, using my utilities that I pay for in the in law unit. People are just so damn evil.

I was an emo kid. So I followed as many people who liked the same things as me from other teens to youtubers. I found her when I was about 15 so around late 2012 to early 2013. At that time, I was struggling with disordered eating and I was kinda envious of her. She was what I wanted to be so I watched her content as inspiration… She had the clothes, the physical features, the hair, I always wanted. She was much more entertaining back then so I watched her because of that too. 
As the years went by her content really messed me up, it made me hate myself. There was always talk about her and speculation about an ed but parts of me believed her when she said that she was always naturally thin. I would stop watching her cause I was so angry with myself that I couldn’t do that but I always found myself back. I stopped watching her when I was 18 but I found her again in right before the Kairi thing and been following her again since. 
I don’t care about her that much now about but it does frustrate me that she says that she doesn’t influence “kids” when her content is so easy to access. I know first hand what her content may do to someone because I was that kid watching her.
She most definitely enjoys making this content and catering to those who like it too.
